title: Autonomous Repository Lifecycle Law (ARLC-1)

supersedes: Earlier disk rules requiring explicit founder approval for every write to main
does_not_supersede: Customer-data, payment, provider-activation, production, public-release, security-boundary, live-action authority requirements

separation_of_duties.principle: No component may discover, approve, execute AND certify the same action. No component may self-certify the action it performed.

roles.MOD-001: Core / precedence + policy load (read-only over actions)
roles.MOD-018: Merge Gate (evaluates eligibility; does not execute or certify its own verdict)
roles.MOD-022: GitHub Connector (executes the merge on a signed eligibility token; does not decide eligibility)
roles.MOD-014: Gate / Witness Engine (independent verification; does not build)

OPERATIONAL_AUTONOMOUS.description: Routine mechanically-qualified repository operations Terminal-0 may perform without a founder gate.

TRUE_FOUNDER_GATE.description: Actions that create new legal, provider, production, customer-data, payment, public-release, security-boundary, or live-action authority. Founder decision required.

HUMAN_EXPERT_GATE.description: Actions requiring qualified human expert sign-off (legal terms, security boundary changes).

connector_boundary.rule: MOD-022 executes a merge ONLY on a signed eligibility token issued by MOD-018 for an exact SHA. The connector does not evaluate eligibility and cannot merge without a matching token.

panic_hold.PANIC: Immediate stop of all lifecycle actions; requires founder/operator recovery.
panic_hold.HOLD: Pause new merges; existing verification may complete read-only.
panic_hold.recovery: Requires a fresh checker + fresh Advisor at a frozen candidate before resuming.

does_not_authorize: provider activation beyond existing disk authority
weakening any safety-floor or governance invariant
